title: Paul McCartney live: Allegiant Stadium, Paradise | 2025
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Allegiant Stadium in Paradise, Nevada, USA, on 4 October 2025.

It was the third show of the Got Back North American Tour 2025. The Got Back Tour lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
